name: Securities Financing Reporting Position Set Report V 01
definition: The SecuritiesFinancingReportingPositionSetReport message is sent by the trade repositories to the supervisory authority system, to report aggregated exposures between a pair of counterparties (except reuse report).

AggregatedPositions.name: Aggregated Positions
AggregatedPositions.definition: Representation of exposures between a pair of counterparties that comprise positions sets, collateral position sets, currency positions sets and currency collateral position sets.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
